retrieval_policy.default_for_external_links: Treat a URL as a discovery lead, not as available content, until retrieval and validation are durably recorded.
allowed_later: Retrieve public resources in an authorized ingestion job.
Pin repositories and course pages to an immutable version or archived digest where practical.
Record source URL, retrieval time, content hash, license or terms, access result, and validator label.
Keep source inputs read-only and copy only permitted artifacts into a per-attempt workspace.
forbidden: Bypass authentication, paywalls, access controls, or license restrictions.
Place secrets, hidden graders, sealed references, private course infrastructure, or another learner's files in learner-visible material.
Infer official-unit status, ordering, or completion from a normalized link record alone.
Silently substitute a current upstream repository for an unspecified historical course starter version.
retrieval_policy.failure_handling: Keep the material unavailable or blocked, record the reason, and make downstream units optional or blocked rather than fabricating content.
